sum: Hour Loop, Inc., an online retailer, engages in e-commerce retailing business in the United States. It sells products in various categories, including home/garden décor, toys, kitchenware, apparel, and electronics. The company sells its products through hourloop.com, as well as third-party marketplaces, including Amazon, Walmart, eBay, and Etsy. Hour Loop, Inc. was founded in 2013 and is headquartered in Redmond, Washington.
ceo: Mr. Sam  Lai (Chairman of Board, CEO & Interim CFO)
